definitions.explanation: A fold of fat under the chin that makes it look doubled.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦{太|ふと}って→太る：01190_futoru⟧{二重|ふたえ}あご⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気|き}になる→気になる：03027_kininaru⟧。
examples.english: I've put on weight lately and my double chin bothers me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{向|む}いて→向く：02304_muku⟧⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ている→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{二重|ふたえ}あご⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Looking down at your phone gives you a double chin, so photos are best taken from slightly above.

notes:
Also written {二重顎|ふたえあご}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {二重|ふたえ}あご⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to get a double chin
- {二重|ふたえ}あご⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気|き}になる→気になる：03027_kininaru⟧: to be bothered by one's double chin
- {二重|ふたえ}あご⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解消|かいしょう}する→解消する：21324_kaishousuru⟧: to get rid of a double chin

WATCH OUT:
⟦{二重|ふたえ}→二重：06464_futae⟧ is read ふたえ here, as in ⟦{二重|ふたえ}まぶた→二重まぶた：23272_futaemabuta⟧ (double eyelid), not にじゅう.
